projects.title: Entra
projects.description: Entra is a web app that allows users to grant access to guests using virtual keys. This application blends hardware and software, and is meant to serve as a solution to those people who live in apartment buildings with the older style door buzzer with the 'TALK', 'LISTEN', 'DOOR' button setup. The technologies required for this project included Raspberry PI, Artoo robotic framework, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, jQuery, AJAX, HTML, CSS. I use this application every day to let myself into my apartment building. The idea came out of me being a host on AirBnB for a few years, and wanting an easier way to let guests into the apartment building when I wasn't anywhere nearby to bring them keys. There is a live version of this app running at http://entra.herokuapp.com and the code can be viewed at http://www.github.com/aceburgess/entra
